title: Agent-Based Modeling of Complex Molecular Systems.
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍基于智能体的复杂分子系统建模框架FLAME及其在NF-kappaB信号通路中的应用，虽涉及分子系统建模但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，方法上无AI或物理模拟的深度结合。
abstract: The seamless integration of laboratory experiments and detailed computational modeling provides an exciting route to uncovering many new insights into complex biological processes. In particular, the development of agent-based modeling using supercomputers has provided new opportunities for highly detailed, validated simulations that provide the researcher with greater understanding of these processes and new directions for investigation. This chapter examines some of the principles behind the powerful computational framework FLAME and its application in a number of different areas with a more detailed look at a particular signaling example involving the NF-kappaB cascade.
abstract_zh: 实验室实验与详细计算建模的无缝整合，为揭示复杂生物过程中的许多新见解提供了一条激动人心的途径。特别是，利用超级计算机开发基于代理的建模（agent-based modeling）为高度详细且经过验证的模拟提供了新机遇，使研究者能够更深入地理解这些过程，并开辟新的研究方向。本章探讨了强大计算框架FLAME背后的一些原理，及其在多个不同领域的应用，并更详细地审视了一个涉及NF-kappaB级联信号传导的具体示例。
